what_happened.line: The town manager presented the preliminary FY21 budget, covering revenue, expenditures, debt and the capital plan; the Finance Committee took no vote on it.
The preliminary budget leaves an unallocated balance meant to cover snow and ice costs and other surprises.
Free cash in the plan goes to capital, the OPEB liability and the stabilization account, not to operating costs.
Residents asked about local receipt estimates, the regional dispatch assessment, a shared recycling coordinator position, and when line-item detail will be public.
Weekly department budget hearings begin the following week at 6:30 p.m., with possible Monday meetings posted as snow-day backups.

why_it_matters: This is the first look at the budget that sets next year's tax levy and town services, and the unallocated balance and the regional dispatch assessment are the lines most likely to move before Town Meeting.
Using free cash for one-time items rather than operating costs keeps day-to-day spending from relying on money that may not recur.
watch_next: Weekly department budget hearings, starting the following week at 6:30 p.m.
A future committee vote on the transfer from the advertising line, which is to be placed on an upcoming agenda.
